hero.headline: A Fresh Chapter Is Brewing.
hero.subheadline: Brunch. Coffee. Bakery. Something new is coming.
hero.description: Welcome to Dispacito — Oran's coastal boutique where artisanal viennoiserie, specialty espresso, and slow-crafted brunch meet refined elegance.

story.title: Crafted with Passion & Heritage
story.subtitle: Nestled on the seaside corniche of Akid Lotfi
paragraphs: At Dispacito, we believe coffee and pastry are daily rituals meant to be savored slowly. Our bakers greet the dawn with golden, flaky croissants and handcrafted confections, while our baristas dial in exquisite single-origin espresso with millimeter precision.

Whether you are joining us for an energizing morning macchiato, a lavish weekend brunch with friends, or an evening dessert under the warm Mediterranean breeze, Dispacito is your warm editorial home in Oran.
